candidates.description: This vector represents short phonetic fragments, suffixes, and character combinations common across diverse linguistic scripts.
This vector activates on common conjunctions and connector words across multiple languages, particularly Thai and English.
This vector represents Thai script characters, diacritics, and common sub-word tokens.
This vector activates on various Thai characters, diacritics, and sub-word tokens, particularly those associated with the Thai consonant "ผ" (pho phueng).
This feature vector activates strongly on the Thai consonant 'ต' (to).
The feature represents common Thai prepositions, conjunctions, and grammatical particles used to indicate source, condition, or relation.
This vector represents abbreviations, prefixes, or root syllables related to names of days of the week across various languages.
These tokens represent common phonemes and short syllables frequently found in Dravidian and other South Asian languages.
The tokens share the letter "k" or the "k" sound in various subword contexts, often as a phonetic component or frequent character.
This vector represents non-English or accented character fragments and multilingual subword tokens.
